active_contract_boundaries: C00 SYS-6/SYS-7: one owner and one writer for mutable state
C00 SYS-8: one canonical implementation path for security-sensitive operations
C00 SYS-16: no externally observable behavior without owning contract
C02 AGT-10/AGT-11: all actors cross the same command/domain boundary; no privileged direct DB access
C14 AUTHZ-9/AUTHZ-10/AUTHZ-11/AUTHZ-21: API-enforced authorization and read-only entitlement input
C15 PRIV-3: protected queries require authoritative scope in data-access layer
C21 MIG-11: browser-reachable roles cannot access backend-owned tables
C41 API-8/API-14/API-15: business rules below routes; commands are the state-change boundary
C42 WEB-14: browser writes only through owned API/application commands
C53 OBS-10: observability failure cannot alter request/authorization outcomes

discovered_architecture_facts.fact: No architecture/ authority directory existed at the baseline commit.
discovered_architecture_facts.implication: Architecture can be introduced without migrating an existing v2 architecture authority.

discovered_architecture_facts.fact: The current active Domain Ownership Map contains 11 semantic domains.
discovered_architecture_facts.implication: The original seven-module source direction cannot be assumed to map one-to-one onto all current semantic domains.

discovered_architecture_facts.fact: C41 makes registered application commands the state-changing system boundary.
discovered_architecture_facts.implication: HTTP, UI, jobs, CLI, and agents must adapt into application commands rather than own business semantics.

discovered_architecture_facts.fact: C00 requires exactly one writer component per mutable state and C41/C42 forbid route/browser ownership of business rules.
discovered_architecture_facts.implication: Cross-domain direct database mutation is not an admissible architecture shortcut.

discovered_architecture_facts.fact: Microservices are deferred by the owner-supplied source decisions.
discovered_architecture_facts.implication: No service extraction is justified at architecture discovery.

decision_required.question: How do the 11 semantic domains map to deployable/runtime modules versus cross-cutting or non-runtime planes?
decision_required.reason: The original source lists seven expected modules, while later approved semantic ownership added Governance, TransactionControl, VerificationEvidence, and Observability.

decision_required.question: What exact dependency rules are enforced between Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and Interfaces?
decision_required.reason: The direction is declared, but import/port/repository restrictions have not yet been approved as architecture rules.

decision_required.question: How are cross-domain reads and multi-domain transactions coordinated without violating single-writer ownership?
decision_required.reason: Contracts constrain the outcome but do not yet define the architecture mechanism.

decision_required.question: Which physical package/app paths implement the approved logical architecture?
decision_required.reason: The source explicitly leaves exact filenames and formats as an implementation decision; this should remain deferred until logical architecture is approved.

semantic_constraints_not_resolved_by_arc.rule: Architecture discovery must not promote, rely on, or synthesize these semantics.

readiness.transport_interfaces: BLOCKED until persistence/application boundaries are approved
